eyebrow: The scientific method, applied to production

steps.label: Define steady state
steps.sub: a measurable normal, e.g. checkout success ≥ 99.9%

steps.label: Form a hypothesis
steps.sub: a falsifiable claim about resilience to one failure

steps.label: Inject real failure
steps.sub: kill a pod, add latency, black out a dependency

steps.label: Compare the result
steps.sub: did steady state hold, or did it degrade?

code:
HYPOTHESIS
Steady state: checkout success rate >= 99.9%
Failure injected: terminate 1 of 3 payment-service pods
Expected result: success rate holds, traffic reroutes

If it holds -> resilience confirmed
If it drops -> a real weakness, found safely
caption: Specific and falsifiable — not "the service seemed fine."
